Printing Techniques

We support three professional printing methods to match your artwork and material choice. Our team helps you select the optimal technique based on your design, quantity, and budget to ensure vibrant, durable branding on every bag.

  • Silk-screen: Cost-effective for simple 1-4 color designs
  • Heat Transfer: Full-color printing for photos and complex artwork
  • Sublimation: All-over full-color printing (polyester only), vibrant and durable

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

100 pcs per design.

Which materials are available for drawstring bags?

Polyester, cotton, non-woven, and felt. We help you choose based on budget and use case.

Can I print on the entire bag surface?

Yes, sublimation printing (polyester) enables all-over full-color printing. Silk-screen and heat transfer are available for other materials.

How long does production take?

5-12 business days for standard orders. Rush service available upon request.

Do you offer worldwide shipping?

Yes, we ship globally via sea, air, and express courier. DDP shipping available.

Not Sure Which Bag to Choose?

Tell us your needs and budget, our consultants will recommend the best solution.
